name: Northking Information Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Northking Information Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the provision of financial technology services in China and internationally. The company provides general software products, such as platforms, image and process management, big data, and artificial intelligence; financial industry application products and solutions, including operations, channel, asset management and related industries, supply chain finance and credit, risk and compliance management, and digital management and innovation services.
